Super Rare.name: Gem-Knight Amber

● Once per turn: You can send 1 "Gem-Knight" card from your hand to the Graveyard to target 1 of your banished monsters; add that target to your hand.

Super Rare.name: Gem-Knight Crystal

You must control another face-up "Gishki" monster to activate and to resolve this effect.

Super Rare.name: Gishki Reliever

Super Rare.name: Gishki Vision

When you do: Banish this card from the Graveyard to target 1 "Gem-Knight" Fusion Material Monster used for the Fusion Summon; the Fusion Summoned monster gains that monster's ATK until the End Phase.

Super Rare.name: Pyroxene Fusion
